## Description and Rationale

I am a student at RWTH Aachen University with a strong interest machine learning and aviation. My motivation for participating in the PRC Data Challenge was twofold: to apply my existing skills to a practical, real-world problem, and to broaden my knowledge of air traffic management and predictive modeling.
